silhouette: Towering plate-armoured knight, shoulders twice as broad as a normal man, slab-like tower shield and a two-handed warhammer
details: Blue-steel plate with worn brass trim, tattered dark cloak, closed great helm with one horizontal visor slit glowing faint cold blue, rune-etched pauldrons
attack: Raises the warhammer overhead and slams it down, hammer head buried in the ground on the final frame
death: Drops to one knee, shield falls away, then pitches forward onto the hammer

silhouette: Ordinary villager turned soldier: padded gambeson, small round wooden shield, plain short sword
details: Deep blue tunic over off-white padding, leather straps and belt, no helmet, cropped brown hair, tanned skin, mud on the boots
attack: Steps forward and thrusts the short sword straight ahead, shield tucked in
death: Staggers back, sword slips from the hand, collapses sideways

silhouette: Lean upright wolf-man, long cream-white fur, oversized clawed gauntlets, whip-thin tail
details: Pale ivory fur with cyan-blue leather harness and arm wraps, no shirt, bare muscled chest, pointed ears, cyan eyes
attack: Two-frame cross slash with both claw gauntlets, body twisting with the swing
death: Recoils, drops onto all fours, then flattens to the ground

silhouette: Slim hooded assassin wrapped in dark cloth, twin curved daggers held in reverse grip
details: Near-black robes with deep violet lining, face fully hidden in the hood except a violet glint where the eyes are, wrapped forearms, soft boots
attack: Vanishes into a low crouch and lunges with both daggers crossing in front
death: Body dissolves into thin violet smoke from the feet upward

silhouette: Small hunched wolf-kin scrapper, patchy brown fur, ember-orange claws
details: Sandy brown fur, burnt-orange leather scraps and a singed shoulder wrap, ember glow at the claw tips, one ear notched
attack: Quick pounce with a forward claw rake
death: Rolls onto its back and goes limp

silhouette: Slender winged forest sprite hovering just off the ground, long recurve bow of living wood
details: Pale green-gold leaf armour, translucent teal insect wings, long light hair, bare feet that never touch the ground
attack: Draws the bowstring fully back and looses, wings flaring wide on release
death: Wings crumple, the sprite sinks slowly and folds inward

silhouette: Practical woodland hunter in a hooded cloak, longbow, quiver at the hip
details: Deep green cloak over tan leather, fur trim at the collar, hood down showing a weathered face, arm bracer on the bow arm
attack: Nocks, draws and releases an arrow in three clean beats
death: Takes the hit in the chest, drops the bow, kneels then falls forward

silhouette: Robed spellcaster wreathed in fire, tall staff crowned with a burning core
details: Deep crimson robes with gold trim, high collar, grey beard, eyes glowing molten orange, small flames drifting off the shoulders
attack: Raises the staff, fire gathers at the crown, then thrusts it forward as the flame bursts
death: Fire gutters out, the robe collapses inward leaving drifting embers

silhouette: Translucent water spirit with no legs, a flowing column of water below the waist
details: Body made of clear teal water with a brighter aqua core, long hair of falling water, faint white foam at the edges, no clothing detail — silhouette is the whole design
attack: Sweeps both arms forward and a curl of water arcs from the hands
death: Loses cohesion and splashes down into a spreading pool

silhouette: Upright priestess in flowing white robes, tall staff topped with a golden sun disc
details: Ivory-white robes with warm gold hem and sash, shoulder-length fair hair, calm face, faint golden halo behind the head
attack: Lifts the staff, the sun disc flares, then lowers it with both hands
death: Light fades from the disc, she sinks to her knees then slumps

silhouette: Stooped hooded witch leaning on a gnarled staff hung with charms
details: Dark indigo robe with violet trim, deep hood shadowing the face, bony hands, small bone charms and vials on the belt
attack: Jabs the staff forward, a violet hex sigil flashing at its tip
death: Curls inward, the staff falls, the body sags into the robe

silhouette: Round-bellied merchant with an overstuffed backpack taller than his head
details: Mustard-gold coat, brown leather straps and pouches, flat cap, no weapon, coin purse swinging at the hip, cheerful face
attack: Swings the pack around and hurls a supply crate forward
death: Sits down hard, the pack bursts and coins scatter

silhouette: Broad, short dwarf smith with a huge braided beard and a heavy forge hammer
details: Rust-brown apron over ember-orange under-tunic, thick leather gloves, soot on the arms, iron rings braided into the beard
attack: Winds the hammer back over the shoulder and drives it forward low
death: Plants the hammer to stay upright, then topples backward over it

silhouette: Knight in gleaming golden plate with a kite shield and an arming sword raised in guard
details: Pale gold plate with cream cloth surcoat, open-faced helm with a dawn-ray crest, warm highlights along every armour edge
attack: Shield-bash forward then a downward sword cut
death: Kneels behind the shield, the shield drops, and the body slides down

silhouette: Stocky soldier in mismatched scavenged armour with a battered maul
details: Rust-red breastplate over dark leather, a torn cloth wrap on the forearm, close-cropped hair, hard set jaw, soot smudges
attack: Two-handed horizontal sweep of the maul that ends chest-high
death: Takes a step back, drops to both knees, then falls face down

silhouette: Levitating mage in storm-grey robes, arms outstretched, hair and cloth streaming upward
details: Teal-grey layered robes with pale mint trim, floating just off the ground, small arcs of white lightning crackling between the fingers and the staff
attack: Both arms rise, lightning gathers overhead, then snaps down and forward
death: Lightning discharges outward all at once, then the body drops limp

silhouette: Gaunt hooded figure half-dissolved into drifting green mist below the waist
details: Muted purple robes, plague-doctor beak mask in dull bone white, sickly green vapour trailing from the sleeves and hem, a stoppered vial staff
attack: Extends one hand and a puff of green spores billows forward
death: The mist thins, the mask tips forward, the robe empties and settles

silhouette: Alert archer in light golden scale, longbow held high, quiver over the shoulder
details: Warm gold scale over cream cloth, a short cape, braided hair, an open circlet, arrow fletchings tipped in white-gold
attack: Draws and looses upward at a steep angle, following through with the bow arm
death: Bow falls first, she sinks backward onto one hip and settles

silhouette: Serene healer in deep blue robes with a wide collar, staff topped with a spiral shell
details: Ocean blue robes with pale ice-blue trim, long dark hair with a single pale streak, small water droplets orbiting the staff head
attack: Sweeps the staff in a wide arc, a ribbon of water following the tip
death: The orbiting droplets fall, she folds forward and sinks down

silhouette: Light-footed pedlar caught mid-stride, satchel bouncing, a throwing knife in hand
details: Olive-green travelling coat with pale trim, cloth wrapped shins, wide-brimmed hat pushed back, several small pouches
attack: Spins once and flicks the knife forward underhand
death: Trips forward, satchel spilling, and lands sprawled

silhouette: Faceless grey wraith, roughly human-shaped, lower body trailing off into ragged tatters
details: Cold slate-grey vapour with pale silver edges, two empty white eye-holes, no mouth, torn shroud edges that never settle
attack: Lunges forward with both arms stretched out
death: Tears apart into ribbons of grey mist

silhouette: Hunched emaciated corpse walking on knuckles and feet, jaw hanging open
details: Grey-brown mottled skin stretched over ribs, torn burial rags in dull maroon, long dirty claws, sunken eyes
attack: Rears up and swipes downward with both claws
death: Collapses into a heap of limbs

silhouette: Floating hollow robe with no body inside, long sleeves hanging empty
details: Deep violet robe with pale lavender inner glow, hood open onto darkness, hem shredded into smoke, hovers a full body-length above the ground
attack: Sleeves whip forward and the hood lunges
death: The robe folds flat and drifts down like falling cloth

silhouette: Four-legged wolf with a mane of live fire along its spine
details: Charcoal and rust fur, orange embers glowing between the shoulder blades, molten cracks along the flanks, smoking paw prints
attack: Leaps forward and snaps its jaws
death: Fire goes out, the body collapses and smoke rises

silhouette: Thick low snake coiled in an S, head raised, no legs
details: Mossy green scales with a darker spine stripe, pale belly, wet sheen, small yellow eyes
attack: Rears back then strikes forward, jaws wide
death: Uncoils limp and flattens out

silhouette: Broad armoured scorpion, heavy claws forward, tail arched overhead
details: Stone-grey plated shell with darker joint seams, sand-worn edges, dull matte finish, no shine
attack: Both claws snap shut, then the tail stabs down over the head
death: Legs fold under, the tail drops and the shell settles

silhouette: Small hovering wasp with a long stinger and blurred wings
details: Bright yellow and black banded abdomen, translucent wings drawn as motion blur, a wet green bead at the stinger tip
attack: Hovers back then darts forward stinger-first
death: Wings stop, it tumbles and lands upside down

silhouette: Robed human cultist with a bowed head and a raised offering bowl
details: Bone-white robe with a blood-red sash and hood lining, face hidden, bare feet, ritual staff with a red gem
attack: Raises both arms and the gem pulses
death: The bowl falls, the figure crumples inside the robe

silhouette: Dead knight in rusted plate, spear held level, walking stiffly
details: Blue-grey corroded plate with pale ice highlights, gaps showing nothing but shadow, ragged cloth tabard, notched spear
attack: Sets the feet and drives the spear straight forward
death: Armour comes apart at the joints and clatters down

silhouette: Lithe humanoid made of solid shadow, crouched low, one dagger reversed
details: Matte black body with faint violet edge light, no facial features except two thin violet slits, wisps trailing from the shoulders
attack: Flickers forward and slashes across
death: Sinks straight down into its own shadow

silhouette: Massive green ogre, one shoulder plated in scrap iron, dragging a crude maul
details: Moss-green hide with yellow-gold scrap armour, tusks, small angry eyes, thick rope belt, scars across the chest
attack: Winds up a huge overhead maul swing that shakes the ground
death: Sways, drops the maul, then falls straight backward

silhouette: Tall shapeless nightmare of dark purple smoke with too many faint eyes
details: Deep aubergine mist with lilac highlights, five or six dim violet eye-lights scattered in the mass, edges constantly fraying
attack: Swells outward and lashes with a smoke tendril
death: Contracts to a single point of light and blinks out

silhouette: Floating woman-shaped spirit, mouth open in a scream, hair streaming upward
details: Wine-red and pale pink translucent gown, long white hair rising as if underwater, hollow eyes, no legs below the gown
attack: Head snaps back then forward with the mouth open wide, scream rings visible as arcs
death: The scream cuts off, the form thins and unravels upward

silhouette: Enormous horned demon lord in blackened armour with a burning halberd
details: Blood-red hide under scorched black plate, curved back-swept horns, molten orange cracks across the chest, cape of burnt leather, tall enough to fill the frame
attack: Plants the halberd, rears back and sweeps it in a wide burning arc
death: Falls to one knee, armour cracks open with light pouring out, then slams face-down

silhouette: Simple rounded blob with a wobbling top, two dot eyes
details: Translucent teal jelly with a brighter aqua core visible inside, glossy highlight on the upper left, small drips at the base
attack: Squashes down then springs forward as a body slam
death: Splits and spreads flat into a shallow puddle

silhouette: Fat segmented grub, low to the ground, blunt head
details: Pale cream segments with tan bands, glossy wet skin, tiny black eye dots, small stubby legs
attack: Rears the front segments up and lunges with its mouth
death: Curls into a comma shape and stops moving

silhouette: Small bat in flight, wings spread wide, ears larger than the head
details: Dusty purple-grey fur, thin membrane wings with visible bone struts, tiny fangs, red pinprick eyes
attack: Folds the wings and dives forward
death: Wings crumple and it drops in a tumble

silhouette: Small hunched goblin sprinting with a crude knife held low
details: Bright green skin, dirty red rag tunic, oversized pointed ears, chipped teeth, a single leather bracer
attack: Skids to a stop and stabs upward
death: Flips onto its back with limbs in the air

silhouette: Bare skeleton in a rusted helm carrying a notched sword and buckler
details: Bone white with grey-brown grime in the crevices, empty eye sockets with a faint spark, a few scraps of leather strap still holding the ribs
attack: Chops downward with the sword in a stiff two-frame arc
death: Comes apart mid-motion, bones scattering, skull last

silhouette: Long-legged flightless bird, body low and forward, running posture
details: Sandy gold plumage with a blue-teal neck ruff, strong scaled legs, small hooked beak, stub wings
attack: Kicks forward with one clawed foot
death: Legs buckle and it tumbles beak-first

silhouette: Sleek pale hunting hound, head low, ears back
details: Cream-white short fur with light tan markings, black nose, amber eyes, lean visible ribs
attack: Springs and bites
death: Rolls onto its side and stretches out

silhouette: Stone-winged demon perched or gliding, hunched shoulders, clawed hands
details: Weathered grey stone body with darker cracks and moss in the seams, blank carved eyes, folded bat-like stone wings
attack: Sweeps both stone claws inward
death: Cracks apart into chunks of rubble

silhouette: Heavy-set orc with a broad cleaver-like sword and a plank shield
details: Olive-green skin, brass-studded leather armour, lower tusks, topknot, thick forearms
attack: Overhead chop with the cleaver, shield raised
death: Drops to one knee, then falls sideways with the shield clattering

silhouette: Lean orc winding up to hurl a short throwing spear
details: Darker olive skin, minimal leather harness, a quiver of spears on the back, war paint stripes on the arms
attack: Rocks back, then throws the spear overhand with a full follow-through
death: Spins with the momentum and drops

silhouette: Elegant ice spirit with a crystalline lower body, arms crossed at the chest
details: Bright ice blue body with white frost edges, crystal shards floating around the shoulders, glass-clear highlights
attack: Uncrosses the arms and pushes forward as frost shards fly
death: Shatters into falling shards that fade

silhouette: Colossal humanoid of stacked boulders with a tiny head between huge shoulders
details: Grey granite blocks with darker mortar-like seams, glowing pale blue runes on the chest and knuckles, moss on the shoulders
attack: Raises both fists together and pounds the ground
death: Runes go dark, then it collapses into a pile of blocks

silhouette: Huge bull-headed brute, hunched forward, massive axe-hammer in both hands
details: Chestnut brown fur, brass nose ring, gold-banded horns, leather harness across the chest, hooved feet
attack: Lowers the horns for a shoulder charge, then swings the hammer across
death: Bellows, drops to one knee, then falls forward horns-first

silhouette: Armoured guardian mummy with a long ceremonial spear held upright
details: Bleached bone-gold wrappings under blue-lapis armour plates, tall crowned helm, ceremonial spear with a blue pennant
attack: Levels the spear and thrusts twice in quick succession
death: The wrappings unravel and the armour drops in place

silhouette: Large black hound with three heads and burning red eyes
details: Charcoal-black fur with red-hot cracks along the ribs, three heads on thick necks, smoke leaking from the jaws
attack: All three heads lunge and bite in sequence
death: The fires go out one head at a time, then the body drops

silhouette: Skeletal sorcerer-king floating above the ground in a tattered crown and robes, holding a long staff
details: Deep navy robes with teal inner glow, bare skull with a broken gold crown, teal soul-fire in the eye sockets, skeletal hands, robe hem trailing into mist
attack: Raises the staff overhead, teal fire gathering, then points it forward
death: Crown falls first, the skull cracks, then the robes collapse into teal fire

silhouette: Monstrous hybrid: lion body, goat head at the shoulder, serpent tail raised
details: Tawny gold lion fur, dark red mane, grey goat head with curled horns, green serpent tail with its own open mouth, feathered joints
attack: Lion head bites while the serpent tail strikes over the back
death: All three heads fall at different moments, then the body slumps

silhouette: Giant flame demon with a molten rock body and a crown of fire
details: Cracked obsidian-red skin with white-hot fissures, no legs below a swirling column of fire, huge shoulders, blazing yellow eyes
attack: Slams both fists together, then throws a wave of fire forward
death: The fire collapses inward, the rock body dims to black and crumbles

silhouette: Nine-tailed white fox spirit standing tall, tails fanned out behind
details: Pearl-white fur with pale blue tips on each of the nine tails, silver-blue markings around the eyes, floating pale-blue orb above the brow
attack: Sweeps forward with a claw while the tails snap outward in a fan
death: The tails fall one by one, the orb winks out, then the body settles

silhouette: Small wooden torsion catapult with a loaded stone in the sling arm
details: Rough timber frame with rope bindings, iron pins, a grey boulder in the cradle, no crew figure
attack: The arm swings up and releases the stone, ropes snapping taut
death: The frame splinters and the arm falls off its pivot

silhouette: Compact three-barrel gun on a swivel mount, barrels stacked in a triangle
details: Gunmetal grey housing with bright cyan rune inlays along the barrels, brass fittings, a small rune core glowing between the barrels
attack: Muzzle flashes travel from barrel to barrel in a fast burst
death: Barrels split apart and the cyan core dims out

silhouette: Wide-mouthed blunderbuss on a squat tripod, bell muzzle facing forward
details: Warm copper barrel with orange-heated bands near the muzzle, dark wooden stock, iron tripod legs
attack: The bell muzzle flares with a wide cone of fire and recoils hard
death: The barrel bursts open like a peeled flower and the tripod folds

silhouette: Short fat mortar tube angled steeply upward on a heavy base
details: Slate-grey iron tube with brass reinforcing rings, dark iron base plate, a faint violet rune ring at the muzzle
attack: The tube kicks and a shell arcs out of the muzzle with a smoke ring
death: The tube cracks along its length and topples off the base

silhouette: Rotary five-barrel cannon on a heavy swivel, barrel cluster mid-spin
details: Steel-blue housing with glowing cyan rune bands, exposed ammunition feed, heavy bolted base
attack: The barrel cluster spins and rattles off a rapid string of muzzle flashes
death: The cluster seizes, throws sparks, and the housing splits open

silhouette: Slim white crystal spire on a ring mount, focusing lens at the tip
details: Polished pale-ivory casing with cyan light channels, a floating crystal prism held in a ring at the tip, no visible barrel
attack: Light charges along the channels then fires a straight lance of cyan light
death: The prism cracks and the light drains away down the channels

silhouette: Fan of five short barrels spread like a hand on a low mount
details: Burnt-orange metal with gold heat bands, five muzzles angled outward, dark scorch marks around each mouth
attack: All five muzzles flash at once in a spread pattern
death: The fan collapses inward and the muzzles droop

silhouette: Ring-shaped brazier on a stand with a spinning wheel of fire in the middle
details: Blackened iron ring with runic notches, a wheel of orange-yellow flame turning inside it, heat shimmer above
attack: The wheel spins faster and flings off a spiralling fireball
death: The wheel breaks apart, fire spills out and gutters down

silhouette: Massive wide-bore mortar with a fire-lit chamber and a scorched maw
details: Dark blood-red iron plating with orange-hot seams, a scorched flared muzzle, ash caked around the base
attack: The chamber flares white-hot and a huge fire shell arcs out
death: The chamber blows open, fire pours from the seams, and the barrel drops

silhouette: Bulbous mortar with a segmented shell visible in the open breech
details: Dark violet-grey plating with purple rune seams, a segmented shell showing in the breech, four small pods around the muzzle
attack: The shell launches and the four pods pop open in its wake
death: The pods detonate in place and the body caves in
